June 4, 2024
6:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
CONSENT
1.
MARCH 6, 2024 ACTION MINUTES
Recommendation: That the Traffic Safety Committee approve the March 6, 2024 Action Minutes.
Action Minutes
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
OLD BUSINESS
2.
CONSIDER THE REQUEST FOR LUNADA BAY PLAZA ON-STREET PARKING TIME RESTRICTIONS
Recommendation: That the Traffic Safety Committee receive the additional information requested at the Traffic Safety Committee meeting of March 6, 2024 and consider the request for Lunada Bay Plaza on-street parking time restrictions and provide direction to Staff.
Staff Report
3.
CONSIDER THE REQUEST FOR CENTERLINE STRIPING ON VIA SOMONTE AND VIA CONEJO
Recommendation: That the Traffic Safety Committee deny the request to install centerline striping along Via Conejo and Via Somonte.
Staff Report
4.
PROVIDE RECOMMENDATIONS TO STAFF ON THE TOP TWO TRAFFIC PRIORITIES TO BE CONSIDERED BY TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-2025.
Recommendation: That the Traffic Safety Committee provide recommendations to staff on the top two traffic priorities to be considered by the Traffic Safety Committee for Fiscal Year 2024-2025.
Staff Report
5.
PALOS VERDES DRIVE WEST CORRIDOR IMPROVEMENT PROJECT
Recommendation: That the Traffic Safety Committee consider options for the Palos Verdes Drive West Corridor and provide direction to staff.
UPDATED STAFF REPORT
ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, JULY 3, 2024, AT 6:30 P.M.
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act.
